title: Quota interaction incomplete: no error defined for exceeding maxSpaceStorageBytes
description: maxSpaceStorageBytes is defined in the account-level capability object but there is no normative text about what happens when the limit is exceeded. What error code does FileNode/set return? Is this covered by JMAP-FILENODE's error model, or does this spec need to define it? Also clarify the interaction with JMAP-QUOTAS.
close_reason: overQuota SetError already defined in RFC 8620 §5.3; spec now references it explicitly
